## Vision filter (`docs/vision.md`)

- [ ] Makes something **more useful** or the story world **more real**
- [ ] Can show **dated evidence** without lying
- [ ] Moves durable craft/revenue forward (even slowly), or clearly supports trust/foundation
- [ ] Would be proud if a local business owner or journalist read this tomorrow

**Out of vision (do not ship):** fake scale / Fortune claims, live store or hiring theater, reverse-engineering third-party apps as growth strategy.
